text: A one-page website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Visitors should see the menu with prices, the opening hours, and where to find us, and be able to pre-order a coffee for pickup. It should feel warm and modern and work well on a phone. Include a section about our beans and the farms they come from, and a simple loyalty-card explainer (buy 9, get the 10th free).
@Adaptation The brief is enough to write the charter. Prices, hours, address, farm details and how orders are received are not given, so they go in as marked placeholders and nothing is invented.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 10 checkable done-when items. Work can start.
@Priority Four workflows to build the whole page, 90 of the 200 budget. Every unknown fact (prices, hours, address, farms, order destination) is a marked placeholder, nothing invented.

proposal.name: Page shell, anchor nav and warm mobile-first styling
proposal.goal_gap: No file exists yet. Need a single HTML document with viewport meta, anchor navigation and the warm, responsive look.
proposal.expected_outcome: One HTML file with inline CSS and JS, viewport meta, earthy palette, sticky anchor nav to each section, hero naming Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, footer, and a reusable visible style for placeholders. Mobile layout works at 360px with 44px tap targets.
outputs: index.html with head, nav, hero, footer, section anchors and placeholder style
proposal.completion_check: File is one HTML document with a viewport meta tag, media-query CSS, no build step, and nav links whose href targets match section ids.

proposal.name: Menu, opening hours and where-to-find-us sections
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot see the menu with prices, hours or location.
proposal.expected_outcome: Menu section listing items with a price on each (marked placeholders in INR), hours section listing all seven days (marked placeholders), and a location section naming Indiranagar, Bengaluru with a placeholder address and a placeholder map link or embed.
proposal.completion_check: Menu items each show a price or a visible placeholder marker, all seven weekdays appear in the hours section, and the location section contains 'Indiranagar, Bengaluru', an address marked placeholder and a map link.

proposal.name: Pickup pre-order form with order summary
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot pre-order a coffee for pickup.
proposal.expected_outcome: Form where a visitor picks menu items and quantities, enters name, phone and pickup time, and on submit sees an order summary. Order destination and payment terms shown as marked placeholders. Pickup only.
outputs: JS that builds the summary and running total on submit
proposal.completion_check: Form has item and quantity inputs, name, phone and pickup time fields; submitting with valid input renders a summary listing items, quantities, name, phone and pickup time; the order destination is visibly marked placeholder.

proposal.name: Beans-and-farms section and loyalty-card explainer
proposal.goal_gap: Visitors cannot learn about the beans and their farms or understand the loyalty card.
proposal.expected_outcome: Beans and farms section with placeholder bean names, roast details, farms and regions, each visibly marked. Loyalty section stating exactly: buy 9, get the 10th free, with a simple 10-stamp visual.
proposal.completion_check: Beans section contains farm details all marked placeholder; loyalty section contains the exact text 'buy 9, get the 10th free'.

text: @Adaptation GRANT on all four as proposed. Total 90 of 200 (shell 15, info 30, pre-order 25, story 20), which leaves 110 for fixes after Audit.
